name: Qilimanjaro
description: Qilimanjaro Quantum Tech builds full-stack analog quantum computers based on superconducting fluxonium qubits. A spin-off of IFAE, BSC, and the University of Barcelona, the company won the Quantum Spain tender to build the first Spanish quantum computer and operates the first multimodal quantum data center in Europe at the Barcelona Supercomputing Center.

news.title: Qilimanjaro inaugurates 10-qubit analog quantum system at Barcelona Supercomputing Center
news.excerpt: Under the EuroQCS-Spain project co-financed by EuroHPC JU and Spain's SEDIA, Qilimanjaro inaugurated a 10-qubit analog QPU at BSC-CNS on May 28, 2026. Two follow-on generations are scheduled for 2026–2027, expanding BSC's MareNostrum-Ona hybrid quantum infrastructure.
